blockWrapper: decorateBlock adds .block + data-block-name and wraps the block in div.<name>-wrapper; the section gains .<name>-container
buttonizationDetail:
decorateButtons() matches `p a[href]` alone in its paragraph AND requires an authored (primary) or (secondary) or both (accent); a bare alone in a

stays a plain link; the emphasis tag is replaced by the classed anchor; a.title falls back to the link text
fragmentLoader: blocks/fragment/fragment.js loadFragment(path) fetches `${path}.plain.html`, runs decorateMain + loadSections on it; header reads getMetadata('nav') || '/nav', footer getMetadata('footer') || '/footer'
icons: decorateIcons turns span.icon.icon- into .svg alt='' loading=lazy width=16 height=16> (alt is empty; blocks set it)
wrapTextNodes: decorateBlock wraps any block cell whose first child is not P/PRE/UL/OL/PICTURE/TABLE/BLOCKQUOTE/H1-6 (or a PICTURE followed by anything) in one
phases: loadEager: decorateMain + first section + fonts.css when innerWidth >= 900 or fonts-loaded flag; loadLazy: header, all sections, footer, lazy-styles.css, fonts.css; loadDelayed: consent-check.js
csp: head.html ships script-src 'nonce-aem' 'strict-dynamic' + trusted types; inline on* handlers never fire
siteButtonMapping: a.button (base) and .secondary = source .btn-secondary (yellow pill, blue text); .primary = source .btn-primary (blue pill, white text); authors write <em><a> for the site's dominant yellow CTA
